name: chang-korean
description: 라오스 학습자를 위한 그림·소리 한국어 단어 앱 (MVP)

scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs && node scripts/make-standalone.mjs && node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs dist-single dist-web
scripts.test: node scripts/check-words.mjs && node scripts/check-translations.mjs th && node scripts/check-translations.mjs vi && node scripts/check-tracks.mjs && node scripts/check-examples.mjs && node scripts/check-mn.mjs --coverage && node scripts/check-mn.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
